```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Clear all existing data
rm(list=ls())

#Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(plotrix)
library(ggpubr)
library(emmeans)

# Get data
Sys.getenv("L1DIR")
L1_dir<-Sys.getenv("L1DIR")
list.files(L1_dir)

# load in data
KBS <- read.csv(file.path(L1_dir,"HOBO_data/HOBO_pendant_data/KBS/KBS_HOBOpendant_L1.csv"))[ ,2:7]
UMBS <- read.csv(file.path(L1_dir,"HOBO_data/HOBO_pendant_data/UMBS/UMBS_HOBOpendant_L1.csv"))[ ,2:7]

kbs_paired <- read.csv(file.path(L1_dir,"HOBO_data/HOBO_paired_sensor_data/KBS/KBS_pairedsensor_2025_L1.csv"))
umbs_paired <- read.csv(file.path(L1_dir,"HOBO_data/HOBO_paired_sensor_data/UMBS/UMBS_pairedsensor_2025_L1.csv"))

# date is a character column - convert to date format
KBS$Date_Time <- as.POSIXct(KBS$Date_Time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
UMBS$Date_Time <- as.POSIXct(UMBS$Date_Time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
kbs_paired$Date_Time <- as.POSIXct(kbs_paired$Date_Time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
umbs_paired$Date_Time <- as.POSIXct(umbs_paired$Date_Time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

```

KBS
```{r}
# create new dataframe with only data from april - august from 7 AM - 7 PM (growing season during the day)
# this is mainly what we'll work with for figures (could always adjust the parameters as needed)
KBS_season <- KBS
KBS_season$month <- format(KBS_season$Date_Time,format="%m")
KBS_season$year <- format(KBS_season$Date_Time,format="%Y")
KBS_season$hour <- format(KBS_season$Date_Time, format="%H")

KBS_season_air <- KBS_season %>%
  filter(month > "03") %>%
  filter(month < "09") %>%
  filter(hour > "06") %>%
  filter(hour < "20") %>%
  dplyr::select(Date_Time, year, month, hour, Temp_C_XP_air_1m)

KBS_season_air$treatment <- "warmed"
```

```{r}
KBS_avg_month <- KBS_season_air %>%  # by month and year, 1m temp only
  gather(key = "treatment", value = "temp", -year, -month, -hour, -Date_Time) %>%
  group_by(month, year) %>%
  summarize(average_temp = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = std.error(temp, na.rm = TRUE))

KBS_avg_year <- KBS_season_air %>%  # by year, 1m temp only
  gather(key = "treatment", value = "temp", -year, -month, -hour, -Date_Time) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(count = n(),
            average_temp = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = std.error(temp, na.rm = TRUE))

# select only 2025 data
KBS_2025_air <- KBS_season_air %>%
        filter(year == 2025)

KBS_monthly_2025 <- KBS_2025_air %>%
  group_by(month, year, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_temp = mean(Temp_C_XP_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = std.error(Temp_C_XP_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

# plotting
ggplot(UMBS_monthly_2025, aes(x = month, y = avg_temp, color = treatment, group = treatment)) +
        geom_line(size = 0.7) + 
        geom_point(size = 2.5) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_temp - se, ymax = avg_temp + se), width = 0.2) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("ambient" = "#a6bddb", "warmed" = "#AE1F00")) +
        labs(x = "Month", y = "Mean Air Temperature (°C)", color = "Treatment") +
        theme_bw()

# calculate average growing season temperature by treatment
UMBS_2025_treatment_avg <- UMBS_2025_air %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    avg_temp = mean(Temp_C_XP_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Temp_C_XP_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")
```

UMBS
```{r}
# create new dataframe with only data from april - august from 7 AM - 7 PM (growing season during the day)
# this is mainly what we'll work with for figures (could always adjust the parameters as needed)
UMBS_season <- UMBS
UMBS_season$month <- format(UMBS_season$Date_Time,format="%m")
UMBS_season$year <- format(UMBS_season$Date_Time,format="%Y")
UMBS_season$hour <- format(UMBS_season$Date_Time, format="%H")

UMBS_season <- UMBS_season %>%
  mutate(treatment = case_when(Plot %in% c("C1", "A2", "B2", "B3", "D3", "A4", "B6", "C6", "D6") ~ "warmed",
      TRUE ~ "ambient"))

UMBS_season_air <- UMBS_season %>%
  filter(month > "03") %>%
  filter(month < "09") %>%
  filter(hour > "06") %>%
  filter(hour < "20") %>%
  dplyr::select(Date_Time, year, month, hour, Temp_C_XP_air_1m, treatment)
```

# 2025 only
```{r}
# select only 2025 data
UMBS_2025_air <- UMBS_season_air %>%
        filter(year == 2025)

UMBS_monthly_2025 <- UMBS_2025_air %>%
  group_by(month, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_temp = mean(Temp_C_XP_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = std.error(Temp_C_XP_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

# plotting
ggplot(UMBS_monthly_2025, aes(x = month, y = avg_temp, color = treatment, group = treatment)) +
        geom_line(size = 0.7) + 
        geom_point(size = 2.5) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_temp - se, ymax = avg_temp + se), width = 0.2) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("ambient" = "#a6bddb", "warmed" = "#AE1F00")) +
        labs(x = "Month", y = "Mean Air Temperature (°C)", color = "Treatment") +
        theme_bw()

# calculate average growing season temperature by treatment
UMBS_2025_treatment_avg <- UMBS_2025_air %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    avg_temp = mean(Temp_C_XP_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Temp_C_XP_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")

```

# all years
```{r}

  group_by(year, ) %>%
```

# paired sensors
```{r}
# kbs 
# just select for ambient air 1m sensor
kbs_air <- kbs_paired %>% 
        select(c("Date_Time", "XH_ambient_air_1m"))
kbs_air <- na.omit(kbs_air)

kbs_air$month <- format(kbs_air$Date_Time,format="%m")
kbs_air$year <- format(kbs_air$Date_Time,format="%Y")
kbs_air$hour <- format(kbs_air$Date_Time, format="%H")

kbs_season_air <- kbs_air %>%
        filter(month > "03") %>%
        filter(month < "09") %>%
        filter(hour > "06") %>%
        filter(hour < "20") %>%
        dplyr::select(Date_Time, year, month, hour, XH_ambient_air_1m)

# select only 2025 data
kbs_air_2025 <- kbs_season_air %>%
        filter(year == 2025)

kbs_avg_month <- kbs_air_2025 %>%  # by month and year, 1m temp only
        group_by(month, year) %>%
        summarize(avg_temp = mean(XH_ambient_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE),
                  se = std.error(XH_ambient_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE))

kbs_avg_month$treatment <- "ambient"

# umbs
umbs_air <- umbs_paired %>% 
        select(c("Date_Time", "XH_ambient_air_1m"))
umbs_air <- na.omit(umbs_air)

umbs_air$treatment <- "ambient"

umbs_air$month <- format(umbs_air$Date_Time,format="%m")
umbs_air$year <- format(umbs_air$Date_Time,format="%Y")
umbs_air$hour <- format(umbs_air$Date_Time, format="%H")

umbs_season_air <- umbs_air %>%
        filter(month > "03") %>%
        filter(month < "09") %>%
        filter(hour > "06") %>%
        filter(hour < "20") %>%
        dplyr::select(Date_Time, year, month, hour, XH_ambient_air_1m, treatment)

# select only 2025 data
umbs_season_air_2025 <- umbs_season_air %>%
        filter(year == 2025)

umbs_avg_month <- umbs_season_air_2025 %>%  # by month and year, 1m temp only
        group_by(month, year, treatment) %>%
        summarize(avg_temp = mean(XH_ambient_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE),
                  se = std.error(XH_ambient_air_1m, na.rm = TRUE))
```

# merge 
```{r}
kbs_air_merge_25 <- full_join(KBS_monthly_2025, kbs_avg_month)

# plotting
ggplot(kbs_air_merge_25 , aes(x = month, y = avg_temp, color = treatment, group = treatment)) +
        geom_line(size = 0.7) + 
        geom_point(size = 2.5) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_temp - se, ymax = avg_temp + se), width = 0.2) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("ambient" = "#a6bddb", "warmed" = "#AE1F00")) +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(10, 35)) +
        labs(x = "Month", y = "Mean Air Temperature (°C)", color = "Treatment") +
        theme_bw()
```

# 
```{r}
UMBS_season_air2 <- UMBS_season_air
names(UMBS_season_air2)[names(UMBS_season_air2) == "Temp_C_XP_air_1m"] <- "temp_C"

umbs_air2 <- umbs_season_air
names(umbs_air2)[names(umbs_air2) == "XH_ambient_air_1m"] <- "temp_C"

umbs_merge <- full_join(UMBS_season_air2, umbs_air2)

# select only 2025 data
umbs_merge_25 <- umbs_merge %>%
        filter(year == 2025)

umbs_merge_25_avg <- umbs_merge_25 %>%
  group_by(month, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_temp = mean(temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = std.error(temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

# plotting
ggplot(umbs_merge_25_avg, aes(x = month, y = avg_temp, color = treatment, group = treatment)) +
        geom_line(size = 0.7) + 
        geom_point(size = 2.5) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_temp - se, ymax = avg_temp + se), width = 0.2) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("ambient" = "#a6bddb", "warmed" = "#AE1F00")) +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(10, 35)) +
        labs(x = "Month", y = "Mean Air Temperature (°C)", color = "Treatment") +
        theme_bw()

```
